title: Home-Only Loan Rate Sheet — Terms, Note Rates and Financed Closing Costs
content:
**Home Purchase Financing rate sheet.** Fixed-rate, level-installment home-only loans of Hearthstone Home Finance. All rates are annual note rates before any autopay reduction.

| Program | Term (monthly installments) | Note rate (%) | Autopay rate reduction (percentage points) | Origination fee (% of price less down payment) | Documentation and title-lien filing fee (USD) | Rate lock (calendar days from application) | Commitment expiry (calendar days from approval) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home-Only Loan 7-Year Fixed | 84 | 8.49 | 0.25 | 1.0 | 250.00 | 45 | 60 |
| Home-Only Loan 10-Year Fixed | 120 | 8.74 | 0.25 | 1.0 | 250.00 | 45 | 60 |
| Home-Only Loan 15-Year Fixed | 180 | 8.99 | 0.25 | 1.0 | 250.00 | 45 | 60 |
| Home-Only Loan 20-Year Fixed | 240 | 9.24 | 0.25 | 1.5 | 250.00 | 45 | 60 |
| Home-Only Loan 23-Year Fixed | 276 | 9.49 | 0.25 | 1.5 | 250.00 | 45 | 60 |
| Home-Only Loan 25-Year Fixed | 300 | 9.74 | 0.25 | 1.5 | 250.00 | 45 | 60 |

**Footnotes**

1. *Autopay reduction.* The reduction lowers the note rate when automatic ACH payment is elected at closing.
2. *Origination fee.* The fee is the stated percentage of the purchase price less the down payment, and it is financed into the loan.
3. *Documentation fee.* The contract documentation and title-lien filing fee is financed into the loan.
4. *Rate lock.* The lock runs for the stated number of calendar days from the application date.
5. *Commitment expiry.* The contract must be signed and funded within the stated number of calendar days from approval.

*Hypothetical reading:* on the Home-Only Loan 20-Year Fixed program, a borrower who elects autopay at closing has a final note rate of 9.24 less 0.25, that is 8.99 percent; one who does not elect it at closing keeps 9.24 percent.
